_comment: Technical Design v0.34's In-World Names: what characters hear in place of the game's own names. Docs, code, the game record, and the system prompts (10a–10d) keep the game names. Setting content: it belongs in the setting pack with the roster, so a reskin renames these in one file. The names load only when both docs use them (since); a prompt never mixes the two sets.

phase._comment: Block 5's {phase_label}. A round of mingling is cut into thirds of its turns: early, midway, late.

time._comment: The short form that opens each block 6 line, in place of T4.

arrival._comment: TD v0.36: the time before the first council (in the mini-game, turn 0: the attendance notes and the opening), in place of "1st round, early". Block 5's phase label and block 6's time label.

narrator._comment: TD v0.36: the speaker code writes on the narrator's memory entries (joins, departures, withdrawals, returns, broadcasts). The same name in the game and in-world.
narrator.name: Il Notaio

acts._comment: Block 9e's act words, in-world → game act. A game word (kill, guard, investigate) is accepted too, without a repair.
